title: City Boy meme mod
description: City Boy is a goofy Minecraft meme mod that adds peak city energy into your world—funny items, dumb moments, and pure chaos vibes. It doesn’t try to be serious, it’s just here to make your game feel loud, silly, and absolutely unhinged in a good way. 💀🏙️
body:
City Boy is a chaotic Minecraft meme mod that brings loud city energy straight into your world. It adds silly, over-the-top features inspired by internet memes and “city boy” moments, turning normal gameplay into constant nonsense. This mod isn’t about balance or realism—it’s about laughs, chaos, and pure brain-rot vibes while you play.
